title_zh: 外交部回应泥石流伤亡人员国籍构成：还在核实中
title_en: Foreign Ministry: Nationalities of Mudslide Victims Still Being Verified
summary_zh: 2026年8月28日，外交部就西藏吉隆泥石流灾害伤亡人员国籍构成问题回应称，相关信息正在核实中。
summary_en: On August 28, 2026, the Foreign Ministry responded to queries about the nationalities of casualties in the Jilong mudslide in Tibet, stating that relevant information is still being verified.
